persoenlichkeit.v: He can delay a decision until it becomes a delivery.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: He can delay a decision until it becomes a delivery. He can spend an entire courtyard inning deciding whether a delivery is permissible. The stitched ball has become his model of a world held together by strict boundaries. He secretly loosens one boundary whenever a neighbour needs more time. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Er wirft gleich. Das Gleich wird noch abgestimmt.

persoenlichkeit.v: She catches everything except the explanation for why it happened.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: She catches everything except the explanation for why it happened. Her building job is to catch consequences while the pitcher receives the applause. She carries the mask at her side because seeing people clearly has become more useful than looking properly protected. Dissonant cards are increasingly difficult to drop. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Sie fängt alles ab. Die Begründung kam wieder zu hoch.

persoenlichkeit.v: He mistakes a swing for a comprehensive strategy.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: He mistakes a swing for a comprehensive strategy. He believes the courtyard's difficulties can be solved by one more emphatic swing. His wooden bat doubles as a pointer during compulsory optimism sessions. A card about listening has left him briefly, and rather productively, without a wind-up. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Die Strategie ist aus Holz. Sie hat sich bewährt.

persoenlichkeit.v: She fields problems before anyone can assign a committee.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: She fields problems before anyone can assign a committee. She intercepts corridor disputes before they reach the official complaint window. Her glove is always open, though the approved categories remain caught or missed. She keeps finding that the most important problems need to be gently put down. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Sie spielt kurz. Die Zuständigkeitsfrage spielt länger.

persoenlichkeit.v: He is always ready for a ball that may simply be a cloud.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: He is always ready for a ball that may simply be a cloud. He patrols the far end of the courtyard for approaching failures. The raised glove offers reassurance to a sky that has requested none. Since finding an ambiguous card, he has started distinguishing danger from a pleasant afternoon. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Er beobachtet die Flugbahn. Auch ohne nachgewiesenen Ball.

persoenlichkeit.v: He steals a base only after obtaining three copies of its consent.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: He steals a base only after obtaining three copies of its consent. He carries a little base bag as proof that every advance requires a recognised destination. The building calls him a thief for arriving before the paperwork. He quietly lends the bag to residents who need somewhere safe to stop. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Die Basis ist gesichert. Sie wird vorübergehend mitgeführt.
